newsitem.title: USA: Kmart to merge some Canada functions into U.S.
newsitem.headline: Kmart to merge some Canada functions into U.S.

text.p: Kmart Corp said Wednesday that, beginning this month, it will begin to merge many of its Kmart Canada business functions into its U.S. operations.
Kmart said these moves are intended to maximize efficiencies and support the operating and financial performance of Kmart's Canadian operations.

Kmart said about 150 positions will be cut by the end of 1997 at the head office in Brampton, Ontario. Approximately 200 positions will remain in Canada and a number of new positions will be created in Troy, Mich., where Kmart Corp is headquartered.
Affected employees will receive severance and other benefits.

Under the realignment, Kmart Canada's financial, systems, store operations and other administrative support functions will be merged into Kmart's headquarters in Troy, beginning in October and completed during 1997.
Remaining functions in Kmart Canada's Brampton office will include executive management and merchandising functions.

"Following a thorough strategic review, Kmart determined that we can significantly strengthen the performance of Kmart Canada by streamlining its operations," Thomas Watkins, chairman of the board of Kmart Canada, said in a statement.

"In recent months, Kmart Canada has significantly reduced inventory, improved merchandise assortments and instituted more effective advertising and marketing strategies. We intend to further capitalize on these improvements by making our Canadian stores more appealing to our customers," he added.
